why: SignalRelay's SA_SIGINFO action records who sent a relayed signal (si_pid) so the app's log names the sender of a quit signal: a fresh-home launch smoke on the signing Mac was ended at launch by a SIGTERM nothing traced (2026-11-25). A C signal action cannot reach instance state, so the record is one file-scope lock-free Atomic<Int64> (signal and sender in one value, one async-signal-safe store), as acpmux's term_sender keeps its SENDER static.
